notes.title: War, the Game: v6.4 New tracks, nations and bug fixes.
notes.content:
Version v6.4 contains

- 3 Brand new tracks by solidaudioworks (www.solidaudioworks.com).
The production company by some of the talented people responsible for the audio of the Grand Theft Auto series.

- The smaller nations in the game are now selectable through 'Pick your Nation' scenario. Nepal can finally beat China. Wales can take over the world.

- Various minor bug fixes. (Nuclear leak fixed)

notes.title: War, the Game: v6.3 Interesting nations for interesting scenarios.
notes.content:
- New 'nations' added to be used in user generated scenarios.
25 real nations as well as zombies, world religions and historic nations.

- A 'Tactical Pause' activated with Enter because some people just like to play that way.

- Workshop (player generated) scenarios can now be started from the main 'Operation Selection' screen. (Steam subscribed scenarios appear in Africa)

- New starting condition for scenarios where player gets to choose nation to play with.

Enjoy.

notes.title: War, the Game: v6.0 with new built in Scenario Editor and in-game Workshop integration.
notes.content:
v6.0 Released February 6th 2015

- A brand new built in scenario editor lets players design their own scenarios including: unit placement, alliances, victory conditions and time limit.
(Select 'Scenario Editor' on the 'Operation Selection' screen to start the fun)

- Upload your new scenario to Steam Workshop with a single button press, for everyone to enjoy.

notes.title: War, the Game: Update (v5.7) out now.
notes.content:
Version 5.7 of 'War, the Game' is now live. (Jan 21 2015)

A new sandbox type scenario called 'Turmoil'.
12 nations are scattered all over the globe. Be the one that ends up on top.

Streamlined Tutorial. Gone are the repetitions and screens full of text.

Bugs fixed:

Random crash. Some players experienced crashes that would occur at a certain point in a scenario. (ie March 2018)

The game now runs properly in 3840x2160.

Savegames now work even if your windows username has non latin chars in it.
